managedService.name: Managed QA
managedService.description: Our team operates Orbit on your behalf. We review test plans, annotate critical flows, triage failures, and deliver monthly QA health reports. The bridge between buying a tool and hiring a QA engineer.

faq.question: What is a credit?
faq.answer: One credit covers one test case execution — the browser agent running a single test, including AI inference. A typical smoke test uses 10-20 credits. A full PR regression run uses 20-40.

faq.question: Can I try Pro features for free?
faq.answer: Yes. Every new account starts with a 14-day Pro trial with 1,000 bonus credits. No credit card required.

faq.question: Do unused credits roll over?
faq.answer: Yes. Credits roll over for 12 months from date of purchase or allocation.

faq.question: What if I run out of credits?
faq.answer: You can purchase credit top-ups at any time. We alert you at 75% and 95% consumed so you're never caught off guard.

faq.question: Can I self-host Orbit?
faq.answer: Self-hosted deployment is available on the Enterprise plan. It runs on your infrastructure with your own AI API keys.
